capabilities: Apply per-canvas themes with node style presets and styled connections
Build mind maps with Tab/Enter node creation, auto-arrange, and focus mode
Annotate PDFs with pinned pages, excerpts, pen and highlighter, and AI OCR
Ask AI about selected nodes and save streaming answers as linked nodes
Export canvases as PNG, SVG, or JSON Canvas and present them
disambiguation: Not a standalone whiteboard app; it extends the built-in Canvas with themes, mind-map editing, and AI features.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.14.4+. README carries security warnings about sending prompts and node content to AI services, local MCP servers running with user permissions, and sandboxed HTML preview. Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later; some AI flows are documented as still needing verification.
intentEvidence: Better Canvas is an enhancement plugin for Obsidian Canvas.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Canvas is a plain whiteboard without mind-map shortcuts, visual themes, PDF annotation, or AI helpers, so structuring ideas and analyzing sources takes manual work and outside tools.

relations.evidence: Some feature directions were inspired by Advanced Canvas, Canvas MindMap, and Obsidian AI Canvas.
